description: Internal outline-planning text (a 'Scene N -- ...' line meant only for cross-chapter awareness) leaks verbatim into a chapter's generated prose. Matches the confirmed leak-fix documented in orchestrator/static.py's SharedContext.outline()/scope_for() comments ('Leak fix (2026-07): this list is INTERNAL planning context... workers sometimes echo its... phrasing... verbatim into finished prose') and the dedicated scrub function _scrub_chapter_leaks.
mechanism: orchestrator.static._scrub_chapter_leaks(text, task_id) -- deterministic, offline, no model call.
source_reference: orchestrator/static.py _scrub_chapter_leaks function and SharedContext.outline()/scope_for() 'Leak fix (2026-07)' comments
input_text:
Larasati stood at the microphone, hands trembling but steady enough to begin.
Scene 2 -- she realizes the letter was never sent, and the truth unravels in front of the judges.
The room held its breath as she spoke the first line.

expected_verdict.leaked_line_text: Scene 2 -- she realizes the letter was never sent, and the truth unravels in front of the judges.

negative_control_text:
Larasati stood at the microphone, hands trembling but steady enough to begin.
The scene around her seemed to hold its breath as she spoke the first line.
